ios.desc:
What you get

• Planty. Your plant. Your companion. Make it bloom by drinking water throughout that day. Make it prosper by building streaks.
• Smart reminders during your day
• Track water from anything you drink. Water, coffee, tea, juice, soda, milk, anything
• 50 Hydration Tips
• Apple Watch app
• Widgets: home screen, lock screen, live activity for during the day and during workouts
• Calculate your daily water goal based on your weight, sweat type, diet, activity, weather, and other personalized hydration parameters
• Streaks that make your plant grow more beautiful
• Celebrate reaching your daily goal with a fun celebration
• History, charts, & statistics
• Apple Health Sync
• Oz/mL measure units
• Siri Shortcuts
• All features are based on scientific research and studies

Benefits of Staying Hydrated

• Stay hydrated during and after a workout using a science-based rehydration algorithm
• Supports healthy weight management
• Helps skin look fresh and healthy
• Boosts focus, productivity, and mood
• Helps reduce fatigue and support energy
• Supports your heart, brain, and immune system
• Helps regulate body temperature and blood pressure

DRINK WATER. GROW A PLANT.

Your hydration lives as a plant. Every sip feeds it. As you drink through the day, Planty grows from an empty pot to a full bloom. Hit your daily goal and Planty celebrates — a halo, ripples, sparkles in your plant's own colors. Miss a day and Planty droops. Miss two and Planty wilts. The moment you log any water, Planty springs back to life.

DESIGN YOUR PLANT

Planty is yours. Pick a pot shape and color. Choose a stem — straight, curved, or winding vine. Add leaves in four shapes. Enable a flower and pick its petals. Name it. Rename it whenever you want.

A LIVING WORLD AROUND YOUR PLANT

Planty breathes and sways while you watch. Leaf colors shift with the real-world season — warm yellow in summer, amber in autumn, cool blue-grey in winter.

THE LONGER YOUR STREAK, THE MORE ALIVE IT GETS

Keep your streak going and they start to arrive:
- Day 3 — a butterfly
- Day 7 — a second butterfly joins it
- Day 14 — a bee starts buzzing through
- Day 21 — a second bee, plus a sparkle trail
- Day 30 — three butterflies, two bees, and a dragonfly
- Day 100 — a second flower blooms on your plant
- Day 365 — a monarch butterfly visits. Only once a year. Only for you.

Nothing you earn ever leaves. Your day-three butterfly is still orbiting at day 365, the day the monarch arrives.

BUILD THE HABIT

quotes.text:
People aren't good at hydration, at least I wasn't, so at the risk of self promotion I have an iphone app called Max Hydrate - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/max-hydrate/id1575744883#?platform=iphone - that calculates how much you should drink to stay hydrated. It's based on research and the most important parts are free.

I had thought about it mostly for working out and athletes, but perhaps in warmer temps it has more general applicability. I've learned older people often suffer from dehydration without realizing it.

It has a WUT test to test for dehydration and uses your sweat profile to suggest hydration products. There are a lot of options these days beyond Gatorade and Pedialyte.

Most people don't get enough salt, so that's something to watch out for, especially if you are a salty sweater.
